ops.text: What CI ran is declared checks: per commit, before a push, before a release
ops.why: sylva is closed to contributions, so ci.closed holds: .github/workflows/ (ci.yml, deny.yml) is deleted and Actions is off. What CI ran is now declared checks that tend's hooks run. Per commit, where a change reaches: clippy and tests with all features (as before), tests without std (as before) and clippy without std (new, on Structures). Before a push: clippy and tests with default features (std alone), and the two wasm32 builds without std (plain and with serde), measured at about 5 s and 3 s from cold here, cheap enough not to wait for a release. Before a release, behind a blocking gate on every test: clippy with each feature alone on the node it carries (serde, log, sign, sqlite, crypt, knowledge, ts; std alone is the default set), which CI never ran and which found a real failure on its first run, and cargo deny (advisories, bans, sources). The `ci on GitHub` gate goes, since no run will ever exist to read. If sylva opens to contributions, CI comes back under ci.open, built from these same checks.
